{
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    ones = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    sixes = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 6]

    # Each diagonal pair of 1 markers defines a segment. Keep any 6 marker
    # already on that segment, and fill the remaining cells with 1.
    diagonals = []
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2, c2 in ones[i + 1:]:
            if abs(r2 - r1) == abs(c2 - c1) and r2 != r1:
                dr = 1 if r2 > r1 else -1
                dc = 1 if c2 > c1 else -1
                cells = []
                r, c = r1, c1
                while True:
                    cells.append((r, c))
                    if (r, c) == (r2, c2):
                        break
                    r += dr
                    c += dc
                diagonals.append((dr, dc, set(cells)))
                for r, c in cells:
                    if grid[r][c] in (bg, 1):
                        out[r][c] = 1

    # A 6 marker lying on a 1 segment spawns a full perpendicular 6 diagonal.
    for dr, dc, cells in diagonals:
        for r, c in sixes:
            if (r, c) not in cells:
                continue
            pdr, pdc = -dr, dc
            rr, cc = r, c
            while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = 6
                rr += pdr
                cc += pdc
            rr, cc = r - pdr, c - pdc
            while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = 6
                rr -= pdr
                cc -= pdc
    return out
